definition: A specific, identifiable subnetwork of neurons and connections within a model hypothesized to implement a particular, interpretable computational function.
details: The concept of circuits is central to mechanistic interpretability research, which aims to identify and understand these functional subnetworks much as one might analyze a circuit diagram in traditional engineering.
story: Picture an architect laying out a building where every room has to know which other rooms matter to it. In plain words: A specific, identifiable subnetwork of neurons and connections within a model hypothesized to implement a particular, interpretable computational function. Here is how it actually plays out: The concept of circuits is central to mechanistic interpretability research, which aims to identify and understand these functional subnetworks much as one might analyze a circuit diagram in traditional engineering. It is the difference between a row of isolated cubicles and one big room where everyone can hear each other. That blueprint is Circuit (in interpretability).
